legacy_record.resolution: CORRECTED 2026-10-10 (S24 probe refutes the original 'ours matches aasdk (0x07)' claim): canonical version-request frame kind is 0x03 (SPECIFIC) per pinned aasdk sendVersionRequest + live probe; the 0x07 (CONTROL) form is a misannotation-derived variant this phone's framer ignores (8 frames, zero response), pinned only as documented fixture variant F-A2. Record-only fix: the project encoder already matched aasdk - the framer stamps the caller-supplied Message.kind (default SPECIFIC), encode(VersionRequest) emits payload only, and no production path frames a version request; the 0x07 form lived only in the fixture record and its equality test, now re-pinned to 0x03 canonical.
legacy_record.summary: 02-version-ssl-auth.md:74 annotates the version frame flags as 0x00 = 'BULK frame, MessageType CONTROL, PLAINTEXT'. Two OAA-internal defects: 0x00 is a typo for the annotated combination (that combination encodes as 0x07 per architecture.md:81-97; 0x00 = MIDDLE+SPECIFIC+PLAIN), and the 'MessageType CONTROL' annotation is a misannotation - it means control-CHANNEL message, not the frame-kind M bit. Pinned aasdk ControlServiceChannel::sendVersionRequest constructs MessageType::SPECIFIC, so the canonical version-request frame kind is 0x03 (PLAIN|SPECIFIC|BULK); the misannotation-derived 0x07 (CONTROL) form is ignored by this phone's framer (S24 probe: 8 frames at 1 s cadence, zero response bytes) while 0x03 draws VERSION_RESPONSE 1.7 STATUS_SUCCESS in 3-5 ms.

findings.rationale: The OAA document is not vendored; the legacy resolution cites an S24 probe whose captures are not in this repository.
